adversarial_findings.status: Resolved in reviewed patch; isolated regression checks passed
adversarial_findings.observed: In an isolated in-memory software fixture with a stale candidate version1 and current running job version4, calling the existing failure cleanup cleared the current conversation pending message and marked it Failed while the newer job stayed Running. No actual private record, credential or model was used.
adversarial_findings.root_cause: Worker failure cleanup could run after its terminal job compare-and-swap lost; helper did not require current terminal job ownership.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Fence failure cleanup by the current job state/version and verify stale/reclaimed-worker regressions.
adversarial_findings.verified_resolution: Terminal failure cleanup runs only after the terminal compare-and-swap succeeds. The helper requires the exact terminal job version/state, actor, tenant and payload under the organisation lock before changing the same pending turn. Tests exercise a reclaimed running job and wrong terminal version.

adversarial_findings.status: Resolved in reviewed patch; isolated regression checks passed
adversarial_findings.observed: Earlier per-invocation bound could reset on durable recovery. New design reserves a call under the organisation transaction lock before generation and never refunds uncertain work.
review_requirements: Initialise ledger with each new user turn; fail closed for historical missing accounting.
Preserve latest ledger through completion and label reservations separately from proven model executions.
Exercise crash, concurrent reservation, cancellation, malformed ledger and stale lease without actual model calls.
adversarial_findings.verified_resolution: Each new user turn starts with a strict job-bound ledger. Reservations commit before model service, enforce current lease/attempt/role/context/deadlines, never refund uncertain work, survive Store restart and are correlated with returned attempt metadata. Missing historical accounting fails closed. Crash, concurrent, audit-failure, cancellation, stale lease and malformed ledger tests passed.
